title: Wild Heart Performing Arts Studio
specs: Youth program created by professional dancer and master ballet teacher Suzana Stankovic
Youth classes focus on holistic, joyful approach to world-class dance training

Studio rental rates vary by group size and type of use

blurb: Guests attend dance classes for youth ages 1.5 to 10 years and adults 18+. Youth classes focus on world-class dance training with a holistic approach, including ballet and creative movement. The studio also offers rentals for rehearsals, classes, auditions, and photo/video shoots in a professional dance space.
